te_root_cause_pre2025.role_change_findings: Flat prior target roles have far lower MAE (~18.9) than sharp prior target growth/decline (~38.6/~38.2). One-year spike/collapse histories also have much larger error than flat histories. TE error is dominated by role instability and veteran persistence more than by one simple age curve or TD-rate rule.
te_root_cause_pre2025.conclusion: Validated v0.4 over-projects older/high-opportunity TEs and under-projects year2/year3 TEs on average, but simple experience/opportunity corrections are too unstable to replace the control.

two_stage_role_survival_point_model_vs_v.decision: REJECT as point-projection replacement. Role-survival probability remains promising for uncertainty/risk classification rather than direct expected-point decomposition.

experience_bias_calibration_vs_validated.decision: Do not bolt historical experience-group bias corrections onto v0.4. WR is directionally interesting but the approach is not stable across positions.
